beschreibung:
Ryen opens with his thoughts on the NBA coming down hard on the Clippers for the Aspiration scandal and why Kawhi is the worst partner in sports. Then, Super Bowl champion Clay Matthews III stops by to talk about his work with Netflix this season, the Rams-49ers game in Australia, his family’s incredible NFL lineage, whether he ever considered not going to USC, and the most devastating loss of his career. Finally, Kyle and Ceruti join for some listener-submitted Life Advice, including a life change after getting dumped and a free PS5 dilemma.
